qs.q: An 82-year-old woman with a femoral neck fracture is being consented for emergency hemiarthroplasty. She struggles to track the conversation and cannot state the proposed procedure or its risks. What legal and ethical principle applies to obtaining consent?
o: Assume capacity lost and operate without consent
Get court order for every minor surgery
Use next of kin and best interests
qs.e: For patients who lack decision-making capacity, clinicians must rely on the next of kin and apply the best-interests principle. Capacity is assumed unless shown otherwise, but when it is absent, surrogate decision-making is necessary.
